sourceTitle: The Improvement of Human Reason Exhibited in the Life of Hai Ebn Yokdhan
description: "The Improvement of Human Reason" by Ibn Tufail is an Arabic philosophical novel written in the early 12th century. This allegorical tale follows Hayy ibn Yaqẓān, a boy raised by an antelope on an isolated island, who develops knowledge of science, philosophy, and religion through observation and reason alone.
